summary: Phase 3A.2 Help Centre (Milestone 1) — comprehensive backend + web frontend testing completed. All 15 pytest tests PASS (100%). Public /help, admin /admin/help-centre, and Command Centre integration all functional. Privacy guarantees verified: drafts never leak publicly, feedback comments only exposed in admin. Full workflow (create→submit→approve→publish→unpublish→archive) exercised on a THROWAWAY test article; the 15 seeded starter drafts were NOT published (verified still at draft count=15, published=0). ContextualHelp on Statement Decoder renders nothing without crashing. No regressions in Command Centre existing blocks.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/help_centre.py is 683 lines — acceptable but approaching the ~700-line split threshold; consider splitting admin vs public subrouters if it grows further.

retrieve_help_knowledge() uses an in-memory lexical scoring loop over every approved/published article. Fine for Milestone 1 (small corpus) but will degrade when the catalogue grows. Flag for Phase 3A.3: swap to a Mongo text index or BM25.

In-memory rate limiter _RL is per-process (uvicorn workers do not share state). For PROD fronting multiple workers, feedback/search abuse protection must move to Redis — same pattern Phase 1 email already uses.
test_credentials: super_admin hello@wayly.com.au / Admin!2026 + TOTP (secret in test_credentials.md). Used pyotp to generate code.
seed_data_creation: Test article 'TEST_iter398 throwaway article' was created, published, unpublished and archived during test_full_workflow; it is left in 'archived' status (not deleted) because the autouse cleanup fixture issues an admin DELETE at module teardown. Final DB state verified: help_articles total=15, all status=draft (seed intact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Milestone 1 Help Centre is clean. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_help_centre_iter398.py (15 tests, ~7s). Reuse the admin_token fixture + pyotp pattern. The 15 seeded drafts MUST remain unpublished — tests assert that. When Phase 3A.3 (AI grounding on human-reviewed drafts) lands, extend retrieve_help_knowledge tests to confirm drafts still never ground, and verify per-draft reply approval flow before anything is user-visible.
